[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: Int) : Int :=
if a = 0 then
  if b = 0 then 0
  else b
else
  let a' := a % b
  if a' = 0 then
    b
  else
    implementation b a'
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma mod_div_gcd
(a b: Int)
: b ∣ a → a % b = 0 →
∃ d, d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ∧ d = b ∧ d ≥ 0
:=
by
  intros h_b_div_a h_mod_zero
  have h_a_neg: a ≤ 0 := by
    linarith
  have h_b_neg: b ≤ 0 := by
    linarith
  have h_d_neg: 0 ≤ a % b := by
    linarith
  have h_b_eq_d: b = a % b := by
    linarith
  use b
  split
  simp [h_b_eq_d]
  simp [h_b_eq_d]
  simp [h_b_eq_d]
  simp [h_b_eq_d]
  have h_d_nonneg: 0 ≤ b := by
    linarith
  simp [h_d_nonneg]

lemma gcd_mod
(a b: Int)
: b ∣ a →
∃ d, d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ∧ d = a % b ∧ d ≥ 0
:=
by
  intros h_b_div_a
  have h_a_neg: a ≤ 0 := by
    linarith
  have h_b_neg: b ≤ 0 := by
    linarith
  have h_mod_nonneg: 0 ≤ a % b := by
    linarith
  have h_d_eq_mod: a % b = a % b := by
    simp
  use a % b
  split
  simp [h_d_eq_mod]
  simp [h_d_eq_mod]
  simp [h_d_eq_mod]
  simp [h_d_eq_mod]
  have h_d_nonneg: 0 ≤ a % b := by
    linarith

lemma gcd_recurse
(a b: Int)
: a % b = 0 →
∃ d, d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ∧ d = b ∧ d ≥ 0
:=
by
  intros h_mod_zero
  simp [h_mod_zero]
  use b
  split
  simp
  simp
  simp
  simp
  have h_nonneg: 0 ≤ b := by
    linarith

lemma gcd_base_case
(a b: Int)
: b = 0 →
∃ d, d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ∧ d = a ∧ d ≥ 0
:=
by
  intros h_b_zero
  use a
  split
  simp [h_b_zero]
  simp [h_b_zero]
  simp [h_b_zero]
  simp [h_b_zero]
  have h_nonneg: 0 ≤ a := by
    linarith

lemma gcd_termination
(a b: Int)
: a % b = 0 →
∃ d, d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ∧ d = b ∧ d ≥ 0
:=
by
  intros h_mod_zero
  exact gcd_recurse a b h_mod_zero

lemma gcd_termination_base
(a b: Int)
: b = 0 →
∃ d, d ∣ a ∧ d ∣ b ∧ d = a ∧ d ≥ 0
:=
by
  intros h_b_zero
  exact gcd_base_case a b h_b_zero
[END]

by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation a b
  use result
  simp [result]

  by_cases h_a_eq_0: a = 0

  simp [h_b_div_a, h_result_div_a]
  have h_result_ge_0: result ≥ 0 := by

  simp [h_result_ge_0]

  simp [h_result_ge_0]
  have h_result_gcd: ∀ (d': Int), d' ∣ a → d' ∣ b → d' ∣ result := by

    simp [h_result_eq_b]
    simp [h_result_eq_b]
    simp [h_result_eq_b]
    simp [h_result_eq_b]
    simp [h_result_eq_b]
  simp [h_result_gcd]
